rows.name: Tear-away Clothing
rows.description: The seams on this clothing are designed to break easily, making it a simple matter (a standard action) to remove these items and walk away with none the wiser.

rows.name: Waterproof Lantern
rows.description: This lantern treats severe winds as strong winds, windstorms as severe winds, and hurricanes as windstorms for the purpose of determining whether they extinguish its flame. It holds enough air to burn underwater for 5 rounds before going dark.

rows.name: Adhesive
rows.description: On command for 10 rds/day, climb speed of 20 feet and +2 enhancement bonus on combat maneuver checks made to disarm, grapple, reposition, steal, or trip when the wearer is using a natural weapon or unarmed strike.

rows.name: Balanced
rows.description: +4 to CMD vs overrun or trip and on Acrobatics check made to maintain balance. Dropping prone is a move action instead of a free action.

rows.name: Benevolent
rows.description: when using aid another action, grant armor's enhancement bonus to ally's AC

rows.name: Bitter
rows.description: On grapple wearer with mouth, DC14 Fortitude save or immediately end grapple. On swallow wearer, DC14 Fortitude or become nauseated for 1 round.

rows.name: Bolstering
rows.description: +2 competence bonus on saving throws against abilities of creature hit in melee or ranged attack.

rows.name: Brawling
rows.description: +2 bonus on unarmed attack and damage rolls, including combat maneuver checks made to grapple. Unarmed strikes bypass magic weapon DR.

rows.name: Clangorous
rows.description: When wearer hit, immediate action to create bang equivalent to a thunder stone. If hit was a critical, can instead create a sound burst (Fortitude DC 13 partial).

rows.name: Creeping
rows.description: check penalty does not apply to stealth. Once per day add enhancement bonus to stealth for 1 minute.

rows.name: Deathless
rows.description: Absorbs the first 10 points of positive or negative energy damage per attack. 25% chance to ignore negative levels

rows.name: Defiant
rows.description: +2 enhancement bonus and DR 2/-

rows.name: Delving
rows.description: burrow speed of 10 feet. +4 bonus on all saving throws against landslides, avalanches, tunnel collapses, and similar effects

rows.name: Expeditious
rows.description: As swift action 3 /day, +10-foot enhancement bonus on all modes of movement for 1 round

rows.name: Grinding
rows.description: Any successful grapple check against wearer causes enhancement bonus hp damage on attacker.

rows.name: Harmonizing
rows.description: +5 competence bonus on Perform checks, but takes a -5 penalty on Stealth checks. Wearer vulnerable to sonic energy damage. Extra round of audible bardic performance abilities

rows.name: Hosteling
rows.description: Stores bonded animal for up to 24 hours

rows.name: Impervious
rows.description: Double its enhancement bonus to hardness, hit points and break DC. Enhancement bonus to saves vs direct attacks on shield or armor

rows.name: Martyring
rows.description: Once per day as an immediate action, when an enemy confirms a critical hit against someone wearing martyring armor, the wearer can heal up to nine allies within 30 feet as if using the mass cure light wounds spell (1d8+9 hit points each).

rows.name: Merging
rows.description: The wearer chooses each round whether to attack with the previously merged weapon or defend with the shield.

rows.name: Mirrored
rows.description: When averting eyes, roll the miss chance twice, selecting the better result and can also deal sneak or precision damage. Add enhancement bonus to touch AC vs rays.

rows.name: Poison-Resistant
rows.description: +3 resistance bonus on saving throws against poison.

rows.name: Putrid
rows.description: Living creatures within 10 feet of the wearer must succeed at a DC 14 Fortitude save or be sickened for 5 rounds.

rows.name: Radiant
rows.description: Shines as brightly as a torch when worn. Once per day, can be brightened to the strength of a daylight spell for up to 1 hour.

rows.name: Rallying
rows.description: Allies within 30 feet of the wearer gain a +4 morale bonus on saving throws against fear effects.

rows.name: Ramming
rows.description: Add enhancement bonus to attack and damage for a shield bash as part of a charge. If it hits, can attempt bull rush as a swift action.

rows.name: Spell Storing
rows.description: Can store a single touch spell of up to 3rd level which can be cast as a swift action when wearer hit by melee  or melee touch attack.

rows.name: Stanching
rows.description: Reduces hit point damage, ability damage, or ability drain by an amount equal to its enhancement bonus if the damage or drain was from a bleed effect. The wearer also adds the armor's enhancement bonus to Constitution checks to become stable.

rows.name: Titanic
rows.description: Wearer is considered one size category larger for the purpose of using or being affected by special attacks that depend on size, such as swallow whole and trample. Once per day on command, the wearer can increase her size as if using enlarge person for 1 minute. Once per minute as a free action add the armor's enhancement bonus to a single strength check or combat maneuver check, or to her CMD against a single combat maneuver. The armor check penalty of titanic armor is increased by an abilities amount equal to its enhancement bonus.

rows.name: Unbound
rows.description: On command once per day can invoke an effect as per the spell righteous might granting DR 5/lawful

rows.name: Vigilant
rows.description: On command once per day can invoke an effect as per the spell righteous might granting DR 5/chaotic

rows.name: Warding
rows.description: Once per day as an immediate action, the wearer of warding armor can activate it to end all active challenge, judgment, and smite abilities affecting her. Can be refreshed as a swift action by the wearer expending one of her own challenge, judgment, or smite abilities.

rows.name: Wyrmsbreath (Acid)
rows.description: On command, the bearer can expend 1 to 5 charges from the shield to have it create a breath weapon in a 15 foot cone dealing 1d4 points of acid damage per charge expended (Reflex DC 11 half).

rows.name: Wyrmsbreath (Cold)
rows.description: On command, the bearer can expend 1 to 5 charges from the shield to have it create a breath weapon in a 15 foot cone dealing 1d4 points of cold damage per charge expended (Reflex DC 11 half).

rows.name: Wyrmsbreath (Electricity)
rows.description: On command, the bearer can expend 1 to 5 charges from the shield to have it create a breath weapon in a 15 foot cone dealing 1d4 points of electricity damage per charge expended (Reflex DC 11 half).

rows.name: Wyrmsbreath (Fire)
rows.description: On command, the bearer can expend 1 to 5 charges from the shield to have it create a breath weapon in a 15 foot cone dealing 1d4 points of fire damage per charge expended (Reflex DC 11 half).

rows.name: Scatter
rows.description: scatter; A weapon with the scatter weapon quality can shoot two different types of ammunition. It can fire normal bullets that target one creature, or it can make a scattering shot, attacking all creatures within a cone. Cannons with the scatter weapon quality only fire grapeshot, unless their descriptions state otherwise. When a scatter weapon attacks all creatures within a cone, it makes a separate attack roll against each creature within the cone. Each attack roll takes a -2 penalty, and its attack damage cannot be modified by precision damage or damage-increasing feats such as Vital Strike. Effects that grant concealment, such as fog or smoke, or the blur, invisibility, or mirror image spells, do not foil a scatter attack. If any of the attack rolls threaten a critical, confirm the critical for that attack roll alone. A firearm that makes a scatter shot misfires only if all of the attack rolls made misfire. If a scatter weapon explodes on a misfire, it deals triple its damage to all creatures within the misfire radius.

rows.name: Sawback
rows.description: This is a modification to any light or heavy blade rather than a unique weapon type. The saw blade on the back of the sword lets you use it to perform crude carpentry.

rows.name: Fragile
rows.description: Fragile weapons and armor cannot take the beating that sturdier weapons can. A fragile weapon gains the broken condition if the wielder rolls a natural 1 on an attack roll with the weapon. If a fragile weapon is already broken, the roll of a natural 1 destroys it instead. Armor with the fragile quality falls apart when hit with heavy blows. If an attacker hits a creature wearing fragile armor with an attack roll of a natural 20 and confirms the critical hit (even if the creature is immune to critical hits), the armor gains the broken condition. If already broken, the armor is destroyed instead. Fragile armor is not broken or destroyed by critical threats that are not generated by natural 20s, so if a creature wielding a weapon with a 19-20 or 18-20 critical range scores a critical hit on the wearer of this armor with a roll of less than a natural 20, that critical hit has no chance to break or destroy the armor. Masterwork and magical fragile weapons and armor lack these flaws unless otherwise noted in the item description or the special material description

rows.name: Performance
rows.description: When wielding this weapon, if an attack or combat maneuver made with this weapon prompts a combat performance check, you gain a +2 bonus on that check.

rows.name: Adaptive
rows.description: The wielder can fire the bow with a lesser Strength bonus (and cause less damage) if desired.

rows.name: Advancing
rows.description: Once per round, when the wielder damages a creature in melee with an advancing weapon, she can take a 5-foot step as a swift action after the attack but before the end of her turn.

rows.name: Anchoring
rows.description: An anchoring weapon pins a target in place and prevents it from moving. As a swift action, the weapon can be fixed in place in a point in space, functioning as an immovable rod.

rows.name: Benevolent
rows.description: Increases the aid another bonus by the enhancement bonus of the weapon.

rows.name: Called
rows.description: A called weapon can be teleported from up to 100 feet away to the wielder's hand as a swift action.

rows.name: Conserving
rows.description: When the wielder misses with a ranged attack, the fired ammunition teleports unharmed to its quiver, case, or pouch.

rows.name: Countering
rows.description: A countering weapon gives its wielder a +2 bonus to his combat maneuver defense against combat maneuvers made to disarm or sunder this weapon.

rows.name: Courageous
rows.description: The wielder gains a morale bonus on saving throws against fear equal to the weapon's enhancement bonus. In addition, any morale bonus the wielder gains from any other source is increased by half the weapon's enhancement bonus (minimum 1).

rows.name: Defiant
rows.description: A defiant weapon helps its wielder stay alive in desperate conditions.

rows.name: Designating (Greater)
rows.description: When a target is hit, allies gain a +4 morale bonus on melee attack and a +6 morale bonus on melee damage rolls against the designated target for 1 round.

rows.name: Designating (Lesser)
rows.description: When a target is hit, allies gain a +2 morale bonus on melee attack and melee damage rolls against the designated target for 1 round.

rows.name: Dispelling
rows.description: A dispelling weapon functions like a spell storing weapon, but it may only store dispel magic.

rows.name: Dispelling Burst
rows.description: A dispelling weapon functions like a spell storing weapon, but it may only store dispel magic or greater dispel magic, both of which may be cast from it as a free action.

rows.key: Special Ability ~ Dry Load ~ Firearm / Ammunition
rows.name: Dry Load
rows.description: Dry load cartridges can be used to load guns underwater or in other airless environments, such as a vacuum.

rows.name: Endless Ammunition
rows.description: Each time an endless ammunition weapon is nocked, a single nonmagical arrow or bolt is spontaneously created by the magic, so the weapon's wielder never needs to load the weapon with ammunition.

rows.name: Furyborn
rows.description: Each time the wielder damages an opponent with the weapon, its enhancement bonus increases by +1 when making attacks against that opponent.

rows.name: Glamered
rows.description: A glamered weapon can be commanded to change its shape and appearance to assume the form of another object of similar size.

rows.name: Glorious
rows.description: A glorious weapon glows with a dazzling light equal to a daylight spell when drawn. Any creature the wielder attacks in melee is automatically dazzled until the beginning of the wielder's next turn. On a conformed critical hit, the target is blinded.

rows.name: Grounding
rows.description: Deals an extra 1d6 points of damage to creatures with the air subtype. +2 competence bonus on saving throws against air- and electricity-based effects, and the weapon itself is immune to electricity damage.

rows.name: Guardian
rows.description: A guardian weapon allows the wielder to transfer some or all of the weapon's enhancement bonus to his saving throws as a bonus that stacks with all others.

rows.name: Heartseeker
rows.description: A heartseeker weapon ignores the miss chance for concealment against most living targets, though the attack must still target the proper square.

rows.name: Igniting
rows.description: An igniting weapon functions as a flaming weapon that also causes the target to catch fire upon striking it with a successful critical hit.

rows.name: Impact
rows.description: An impact weapon deals damage as if the weapon were one size category larger. In addition, any bull rush combat maneuver the wielder attempts while wielding the weapon gains a bonus equal to the weapon's enhancement bonus.

rows.name: Impervious
rows.description: An impervious weapon is warded from damage and decay.

rows.name: Invigorating
rows.description: After an attack with this weapon drops a living foe (kills it or drops it to negative hit points), the weapon infuses its wielder with vigor.

rows.name: Ki Intensifying
rows.description: After a successful strike with a ki intensifying weapon, the wielder can spend 1 ki point as a swift action to perform a combat maneuver.

rows.name: Lifesurge
rows.description: A lifesurge weapon boosts and sustains the wielder's life energy while he is in the throes of combat.

rows.name: Limning
rows.description: On a successful strike against a creature affected by a means of magical concealment, the weapon outlines the creature in faerie fire (as the spell) for 1 round.

rows.name: Lucky
rows.description: A lucky firearm has its own magical reservoir of 1 grit point.

rows.name: Lucky (Greater)
rows.description: A greater lucky firearm has its own magical reservoir of 3 grit points.

rows.name: Mimetic
rows.description: Each time the wielder damages a creature using a mimetic weapon, he gains resistance 10 to one energy type that the creature is resistant or immune to for 1 round.

rows.name: Negating
rows.description: A negating weapon briefly nullifies some forms of damage reduction when it damages a creature.

rows.name: Neutralizing
rows.description: Deals an extra 1d6 points of damage to creatures with the earth subtype. +2 competence bonus on saving throws against acid- and earth-based effects, and the weapon itself is immune to acid damage.

rows.name: Nimble Shot
rows.description: A nimble shot weapon doesn't provoke attacks of opportunity when fired.

rows.name: Nullifying
rows.description: A creature that takes damage from the weapon, has its spell resistance reduced by 1 for 1 minute. On a confirmed critical hit, its spell resistance is instead reduced by an mount equal to the weapon's critical multiplier.

rows.name: Ominous
rows.description: An ominous weapon trails a shadowy haze behind every stroke, and moans a menacing dirge in battle. An ominous weapon adds its enhancement bonus on Intimidate checks made by the wielder. In addition, when an ominous weapon confirms a critical hit, the target is shaken for 1 minute (DC 13 Will negates).

rows.name: Phase Locking
rows.description: A creature damaged by a phase locking weapon is affected as though by the dimensional anchor spell for 1 round.

rows.name: Planar
rows.description: When used to attack outsiders, a planar weapon ignores 5 points of their damage reduction.

rows.name: Quenching
rows.description: Deals an extra 1d6 points of damage to creatures with the fire subtype. +2 competence bonus on saving throws against fire-based effects, and the weapon itself is immune to fire damage.

rows.name: Reliable
rows.description: Reduces the misfire value of the affected firearm by 1 (minimum 0).

rows.name: Reliable (Greater)
rows.description: Reduces the misfire value of the affected firearm by 4 (minimum 0).

rows.name: Repositioning
rows.description: +2 enhancement bonus on combat maneuver checks to reposition a foe. On a critical hit with the weapon, wielder can attempt to reposition his opponent as a free action.

rows.name: Seaborne
rows.description: With the weapon in hand, the wielder gains a bonus on Swim checks equal to twice the weapon's enhancement bonus. In addition, the wielder does not take the normal penalties to attack and damage rolls imposed by being underwater, as if he were subject to the spell freedom of movement.

rows.name: Second Chance
rows.description: Once per round, when a shot made with this weapon misses its target, as a free action the weapon's wielder can cause that shot to swerve and try to hit the target again.

rows.name: Spellstealing
rows.description: A spellstealing weapon allows its wielder to siphon protective magic from a target and transfer it to herself.

rows.name: Stalking
rows.description: As a standard action, a character wielding a stalking weapon can command it to study a creature within 60 feet. When the wielder attacks the studied creature, on a successful hit the stalking weapon deals +1d6 points of bonus damage per consecutive round spent studying a target, up to a number of bonus dice equal to the stalking weapon's enhancement bonus.

rows.name: Thawing
rows.description: Deals an extra 1d6 points of damage to creatures with the cold subtype. +2 competence bonus on saving throws against ice-based effects, and the weapon itself is immune to cold damage.

rows.name: Valiant
rows.description: When a cavalier wielding a valiant weapon targets a foe with his challenge ability, the valiant weapon deals an additional 1d6 points of damage against that foe. The wielder receives a +2 bonus on combat maneuver checks made to disarm or sunder a challenged foe's weapon as well as a +4 bonus to his CMD against disarm and sunder attacks from that foe.

rows.name: Cruel
rows.description: When the wielder strikes a creature that is frightened, shaken, or panicked with a cruel weapon, that creature becomes sickened for 1 round. When the wielder uses the weapon to knock unconscious or kill a creature, he gains 5 temporary hit points that last for 10 minutes.
